Interestingly, the differences in fat-free mass between the groups was specific to the lower-body musculature, where a significant advantage was noted for those in an energy surplus. Greater increases in fat-free mass associated with the energy surplus were accompanied by an increased fat deposition compared to the eucaloric condition (1.1 vs. 0.2 kg, or 2.4 vs. 0.4 lb, respectively).
